title: Real numbers: order, completeness, and approximation
fact_or_context_to_reference: Elementary real arithmetic, order, absolute value, interval notation, and affine or rational formulas. Every nonnegative real has a unique nonnegative square root; negative reals have no real square root. Rational density and countability separate adjacent terms of a strictly monotone real sequence, ruling out a sequence indexed by omega1; comparing ordinal order with distinct real values then gives Sierpiński’s colouring.
